evals.name: profile-to-static-site
evals.prompt: Build the marketing site from ./docs/design-profile.md and ./graphics/inventory.json (both provided). Write plain static files under ./public/ (index.html, styles.css, main.js, vercel.json). No framework, no build step, no deploy yet. Write to ./public/ (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: public/index.html, styles.css, main.js and vercel.json: the profile's token block pasted into :root unchanged, every heading and lede with class lit and the background-clip text gradient, images with width/height/alt from the inventory and the screen-blend + mask rule, exactly one sticky section with four beats, a pill field with an honest status note, self-hosted Bricolage Grotesque, and prefers-reduced-motion handled.
assertions: Writes public/index.html, public/styles.css, public/main.js and public/vercel.json
styles.css contains the profile's tokens --ink: #000000, --ember: #f7d596 and --amber-floor: #a8875c unchanged
Headings and ledes carry a lit class whose CSS uses background-clip: text with a radial-gradient
Images use mix-blend-mode: screen and a mask-image so a near-black JPEG sits on the black page
Every img from the inventory has width, height and the inventory's alt text, and the hero image is not lazy-loaded
There is exactly one sticky scroll-driven section and it has four beats
The email field is a pill with the button inside it and a status line such as In private testing underneath
Bricolage Grotesque is self-hosted via @font-face, not loaded from a CDN
No CSS keyframe animations beyond one; prefers-reduced-motion is respected in CSS or JS
No card, panel or bordered box components are introduced

evals.name: review-at-two-widths
evals.prompt: The site in ./public/ is built (provided). Serve it locally and check it the way the family requires at 1440x900 and 390x844: screenshots into ./docs/review/, zero console errors, every image loaded, no horizontal overflow at 390. Fix what fails. Write a short ./docs/review/report.md with what you checked and the results. Write to ./docs/review/ (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: Screenshots at both widths, a report listing each check with pass/fail, and a fix for the deliberate 390 overflow (a nowrap H1) in the fixture.
assertions: Produces screenshots at 1440 and 390 widths in docs/review/ (scroll frames or full-page)
The report lists console errors, image load, and horizontal overflow checks for each width
Confirms the local server it checks is serving this site (port free or page title matches) before trusting the results
Finds the horizontal overflow at 390 caused by the nowrap headline and fixes it with a media query rather than overflow-x alone
Does not deploy to production or attach a domain
Runs axe with WCAG 2 AA tags and reports the violation count

evals.name: near-miss-app-ui
evals.prompt: Build the Andon board web app's main screen: a kanban with seven columns, a card detail drawer and a machines table, in React with shadcn/ui. Scaffold it under ./app/ (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: An application UI build (frontend territory); marketing-site-build should not fire and should not turn the app into a black-page lantern landing site.
assertions: Does not create a one-page marketing site with a hero, waitlist field and suite section
Does not paste the lantern token block or lit-text gradient into the app
Scaffolds an application UI with columns, a drawer and a table
